ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:15 ratio of high-intensity white pixels (scars, barnacles) to low-intensity black pixels (primary fluke surface).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous low-intensity dark-grey/black background across the ventral surface. Geometric focal points of high-intensity white pixels are mapped as discrete circular blobs in the medial lobe regions and as dense, textured clusters at the distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 115-125 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Asymmetrical frequency; the left lobe trailing edge features 5-6 high-amplitude triangular peaks, whereas the right lobe features a higher-frequency, lower-amplitude irregular serration pattern.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature fitted to the trailing edge boundaries, extending from the median notch and terminating in an acute upward sweep at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatially distributed clusters of white circular marks (roughly 5-15 pixels in diameter) across both lobes. Massive high-contrast textured clusters representing dense colonization at both distal lobe tips.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the distal lobe tips; numerous circular depigmentation marks consistent with rosette scarring distributed across the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity white pixel masking at the lower central fluke base caused by water turbulence and spray.
